lesson: A source passage can pass evidence review and CMS validation yet remain absent from the public template. Placement eligibility must be confirmed against rendered HTML; CMS-only success is insufficient.
policy_action: Keep rendered crawlability as a hard post-apply gate. Roll back non-rendering canaries and require a newly evidenced visible placement with fresh approval.

destination_fact: The Kuwait Cloud-Based Order Management Systems Market reaches USD 137 Mn in 2032 at a 13.9% revenue CAGR for 2025–2032.
current_sentence: For execution, order management systems—a market projected to reach USD 137 Mn by 2032—coordinate stock reservations and fulfilment against forecast-led inventory plans.
learning: A single publicly visible destination fact can improve information scent when it directly supports the source context. It does not override indexability, canonical or relevance gates.

current_sentence: For execution, order management systems help turn inventory forecasts into stock reservations and fulfilment plans. The Kuwait market is projected to reach USD 137 Mn by 2032.
learning: Avoid em dashes and other repeated AI-writing signals. Prefer short sentences and ordinary punctuation while preserving evidence, meaning and placement.

Only owner-approved topic links were published. A useful destination fact and natural contextual bridge can improve information scent, but staging noindex/nofollow prevents authority transfer and remains a separate hard gate.
